description:
Construction of a single storey outbuilding on multiple angle sloped ground to be used as a garden shed and hobby space. The wooden and composite structure will be placed on a platform raised on ground screws. The platform will be partially placed on top of a previously installed, smaller shed concrete base, with the additional area extending to the south and east of the concrete base. due to the slope of the garden, an area to the south of the concrete base will be excavated approximately 30cm in depth. The total height of the building, from the tallest point of the single sloped roof, including the platform and feet it requires is 2.73m. The ground immediately to the West of the building is 33cm higher than the concrete base. Measured from the highest ground around the structure, the tallest point of the roof would be 2.405m.

The building is divided into two rooms with separate entrances. To accommodate access, a deck on the east face of the structure is proposed, built as a continuation of the platform. Stairs will be in line with the main doors, with the deck serving as access to the second door without the requirement for a second flight of stairs. Due to the slope of the garden, the deck will be raised between 38cm-73cm from the ground to the lowest point of the platform.

This development was thought to be permitted development however the installers provided additional information concerning the height of the platform being additional to advertised heights. Construction of the shed was paused upon this discovery. The platform has been installed, but will be removed and lowered upon receiving planning approval. A planning inspector has been to review the platform and found no issue with it.
